name: hueframe-workspace
description: Turn a photo into a website palette. Framework-independent theme engine plus a Next.js playground.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace hueframe && npm run build --workspace @hueframe/demo
scripts.dev: npm run build:package && npm run dev --workspace @hueframe/demo
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:package && npm run typecheck --workspace hueframe && npm run typecheck --workspace @hueframe/demo
